title: agropyron kokonoricum
intro: Agropyron kokonoricum, commonly known as Kobresia, is a type of plant species belonging to the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its health benefits, which include its potential to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Agropyron kokonoricum include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may help in reducing swelling and preventing the growth of microorganisms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
